applies_to: EBTRON Advantage IV airflow/temperature transmitters (GTx116e, GTx108e) and EB-Flow2 dual-location units.
summary: EBTRON's Advantage IV transmitters report averaged airflow and temperature from thermal dispersion probes, plus optional humidity, pressure and per-sensor traverse data. One object list covers the whole family: which objects exist depends on the transmitter model and probe types connected. Per the Network Port notes, the GTB, GTM and GTS variants carry the BACnet IP settings and the GTB and GTC variants the MS/TP settings.
firmware: Fan Area objects (AV2-AV9) and Network Port need GTM output card FW 4.17+, GTC FW 8.33+ or GTB FW 8.35+
notes: All objects are conditional: they only appear if the matching sensors/probe type/transmitter variant are present.
AV2 is AMD[-2] Area on EB-Flow2 dual-location units but Fan 1 Area on fan-probe units; AV2-AV9 carry Fan 1-8 Area.
Node velocity/temperature objects (AV21-AV56) are only populated after enabling traverse data in AV10, and only up to the installed node count.
Analog Input present values can only be written after setting Out_Of_Service; COV increment and units are writable.
Units follow the transmitter's IP/SI setting (bracketed values are SI).

integration.summary: This is a read-only measurement device for a BMS. Map average airflow and temperature (AI1/AI2) and the alarm status, plus RH/dew point/enthalpy or the second location if those options are fitted. Per-node traverse data has to be turned on with AV10 before those objects carry values.

minimum_points.name: AMD[-1] Area
minimum_points.why: Area used for the flow calculation

setup: The Device object is listed as instance 2; Object_Identifier, name, description, APDU timeout, Max Master (up to 127) and Max Info Frames (up to 255) are writable.
Network Port object NP1 (newer firmware) holds the BACnet IP mode and foreign-device BBMD settings on B/M/S variants, and Max Master/Max Info Frames on B/C variants.
gotchas: Objects only exist when the matching probes, options and transmitter variant are present.
AV2 means AMD[-2] Area on EB-Flow2 units but Fan 1 Area on fan-probe units.
Analog Input present values can only be written after setting Out_Of_Service.

note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source). Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
